The request total is bounded by (i) the 'reasonable charge' standard, (ii) the 'most economical means' duty (GA-0020) and (iii) the component caps (salary-based labor ceiling, 10¢ page cap, actual media cost). rules.deMinimis.label: De-minimis: no charge below ($)
rules.deMinimis.notes: No de-minimis waiver amount. The $25.00 figure in (d) is an estimate-notice trigger, not a no-charge floor. Guidance (LE guide) says an agency 'is not required to charge' at all, which is discretion, not a threshold. Searched: O.C.G.A. §§ 50-18-70 through 50-18-77 (full text of § 50-18-71(a)-(j) …

rules.minFee.label: Minimum fee
rules.minFee.notes: No minimum fee in statute or guidance. Searched: O.C.G.A. §§ 50-18-70 through 50-18-77 (full text of § 50-18-71(a)-(j) opened; § 50-18-77 opened via AG guide appendix); Legislative Counsel summaries of general statutes enacted 2024, 2025 and 2026 sessions (only 2025 SB 12 / Act 276 touched § 50-1…

media.label: Electronic media (CD/DVD/USB) charge
media.value: the actual cost of the media on which the records or data are produced
media.unit: USD per unit of media (actual cost)
media.notes: Media is chargeable only at actual cost; no fixed CD/DVD/USB schedule. AG-approved LE guide adds (guidance) that 'no charges other than those directly attributable to providing access may be charged where the records are made available by electronic means.'

delivery.label: Delivery: mail / handling / email / pickup
delivery.value: reasonable fee for the administrative costs associated with ... mailing of public records (guidance); statute names 'production or copying costs' without mentioning postage
delivery.authority: AG-approved 'Georgia Law Enforcement and the Open Records Act' (3d ed. 2014) Part D.2, restating O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(c)
delivery.notes: No email/pickup charge basis anywhere; email delivery would carry only the labor and (if any) media components. Resolution word chosen because the standard stated is 'reasonable ... administrative costs', not a number.

certification.label: Certification / certified-copy charge
certification.value: route_to_specific_statutory_fee_if_prescribed; otherwise general (c)(1)-(c)(2) charges apply — no general municipal certified-copy fee in the ORA
certification.notes: The engine needs the branch (GA-0021), not a value: where another Code section prescribes a fee for a record type, that fee displaces the ORA's search/copy charges. AG Official Opinion 2012-5 applied this clause to a state authority's fee schedule.

av.label: Audio/video: per recording, per minute, free minutes
av.unit: USD per recording / per minute; free minutes
av.notes: No per-recording, per-minute or free-minutes rule for audio/video (including body-worn/in-car video); such records fall under the general regime — media at actual cost (GA-0019) and salary-capped redaction labor after the free quarter hour (GA-0016/0017). LE guide sample estimate lists '$10/copy'…

commercial.label: Commercial-purpose schedule (surcharge %, labor becomes chargeable)
commercial.notes: The ORA does not distinguish commercial from non-commercial requesters for fee purposes; the same permissions and caps apply to every requester and no purpose statement is required. Searched: O.C.G.A. §§ 50-18-70 through 50-18-77 (full text of § 50-18-71(a)-(j) opened; § 50-18-77 opened via AG gu…

waiver.label: Fee waiver: grounds, mandatory vs discretionary, purpose statement, written denial, appeal
waiver.value: discretionary waiver: fees are a Permission ('may impose'), agency 'may waive any charges' (guidance); no statutory grounds, purpose statement, written-denial or appeal requirement; mandatory no-fee category for written grand-jury/taxing-authority/law-enforcement/prosecutor investigative requests (§ 50-18-77) and for mere inspection of routinely-inspectable records (case law via AG guide)
waiver.authority: O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(c)(1); O.C.G.A. § 50-18-77; AG-approved LE guide (2014) Part D.1; AG/GFAF guide (2019) p. 5
waiver.notes: Resolved for municipalities as defers_to_city: the state neither mandates nor structures a waiver, leaving whether/when to charge to the agency, subject to the two mandatory no-fee situations (GA-9002 statutory; GA-9003 case-law via guidance).

waiver.forfeiture.label: Late response forfeits the fee
waiver.forfeiture.notes: No provision forfeits fees for a late response; late-response consequences are enforcement (attorney's fees, civil penalties under §§ 50-18-73/74), which are outside the fee schedule. Prior link to GA-0025 (prior-debt prepayment) was a mis-association. Searched: O.C.G.A. §§ 50-18-70 through 50-18…

repeat.label: Repeat / aggregated requests (carry-forward, aggregation threshold)
repeat.notes: No aggregation threshold, no carry-forward of unused free time, no repeat-request fee rule. The only cross-request linkage is requester-level: prior unpaid costs allow prepayment to be required on future requests (GA-0025). fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: In addition to labor charges, an agency may charge for copying, not to exceed 10 cents per page for letter or legal size documents, or the actual cost of producing the copy for other document types.

fee.labor_charge.summary: An agency may impose a reasonable charge for search, retrieval, and redaction, but that charge shall not exceed the prorated hourly salary of the lowest paid full-time employee who, in the custodian's reasonable discretion, has the necessary skill and training to perform the request.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: An agency shall utilize the most economical means reasonably calculated to identify and produce responsive, nonexcluded documents.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: For electronic records, the agency may charge the actual cost of the media on which the records or data are produced.

fee.free_allowance.summary: No labor charge may be made for the first quarter hour of search, retrieval, or redaction.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Where a specific fee for certified copies or other records is authorized or prescribed by law, that specific fee applies instead of the general search/retrieval/copy charges when such records are sought.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: An agency that designates one or more open records officers shall make the designation in writing, immediately provide notice of them to any person on request (orally or in writing), notify the county legal organ, and, if it has a website, prominently display the designation.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Where a specific fee for certified copies or other records is authorized or prescribed by law, that specific fee applies instead of the general search/retrieval/copy charges when such records are sought.

payment.advance_payment.summary: Where the estimated production cost exceeds $500.00, the agency may insist on prepayment of the costs before beginning search, retrieval, review, or production.
payment.advance_payment.clock_spec: processing paused pending prepayment when estimate exceeds $500.00
